column1: # Maps an nf-core pipeline name to the branch of nf-core/test-datasets that
# holds its test profile's data, for `download_nfcore_pipeline.sh --with-testdata`.
# NOTE: unlike pipeline2subcategory.tsv, keys here are the BARE pipeline
# slug without the "nf-core-" prefix (e.g. "rnaseq") -- that's what
# download_nfcore_pipeline.sh's --name takes and already holds as
# pipeline_name, so no prefix-stripping is needed for this lookup.
# Only list a pipeline here if its test-datasets branch name differs from
# the pipeline slug; lookup_testdata_branch() falls back to the slug itself
# (e.g. rnaseq -> rnaseq branch) when there's no entry here.
